scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix ddd/backend" "npm run dev --prefix ddd/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ddd/backend && npm run build --prefix ddd/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix ddd/backend && npm run test --prefix ddd/frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix ddd/backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix ddd/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix ddd/backend && npm run lint --prefix ddd/frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix ddd/backend && npm run format --prefix ddd/frontend
